p4_b0.ocr: In the evolving landscape of real estate and investment trusts (REITs), the logistics sector has emerged as a critical component of the North American economy, particularly in response to the surge in e-commerce and demand for rapid fulfillment capabilities.

p4_b1.ocr: As highlighted in our analysis, the expansion of logistics warehouse facilities is not only vital for optimizing supply chain efficiencies but also for accommodating the shifting needs of businesses and consumers alike.
